profile.headline: Peacock of Darkness | Brex
profile.summary: Cloud platform and on-premise infrastructure engineer utilizing AWS, Kubernetes, global networking, infrastructure-as-code, and other modern practices to build efficient and scalable compute platforms. Excellent communicator; able to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical individuals of all levels in order to successfully solve complex business challenges. Demonstrates a strong work ethic, flexibility and commitment. Enjoys working as part of a team and learns quickly on the job

positions.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and implemented cost allocation pipelines tying cloud spend to individual teams to drive cost savings
* Building/managing/scaling global kubernetes platforms across multi-cloud and mutli-regional environments (GCP/AWS/on-prem)
* Infrastructure-as-Code: terraform, flux, Argo, Jenkins
* Metrics, alerting systems, budgeting allocations, and other proactive SRE duties
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Cross-platform Development · Network Infrastructure · Linux

positions.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked with AI teams and implemented infrastructure, access control, and SageMaker domains.
* Designed, architected, and implemented global intranet networking infrastructure, code patterns, configuration, IPAM, and live-migrated existing systems.
* Rearchitected and implemented a formerly single-region-only Kubernetes deployment infrastructure to accommodate multiple cluster deployments across multiple regions.
* EKS/Kubernetes observability, upgrades, creation, reliability, and costs tuning.
* Designed, architected, and implemented enterprise SSO integration with AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform Cloud.
* Key technologies: AWS, EKS, IAM, Terraform, Golang, gitops, flux CD, Transit Gateways
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Kubernetes · Network Infrastructure · Terraform · Single Sign-On (SSO)

positions.title: Technical Lead - Platform
positions.description:
* Managed a team of 7 engineers overseeing the on-premise and cloud compute platforms at Braintree
* Designed, implemented, and managed Kubernetes platforms in physical datacenters as well as AWS
* Migrated primary business logic applications from on-premise to run on Kubernetes in AWS.
* Key technologies: AWS, Networking (ingress/routing/subnetting/BGP), Kubernetes, Ansible/Puppet/Terraform, Calico, Linux, LDAP

patents.title: Hosted sensitive data form fields for compliance with security standards
patents.description: Systems and methods providing, by a third party, input form fields for sensitive data on a web page provided by an organization. A user may request a web page from an organization, such as a merchant's checkout web page, that requires entry of sensitive data. The merchant's checkout web page may include reference to a script file that provides hosted sensitive data form fields. In response to rendering the merchant web page in a web browser of the user, a request to provide sensitive data form fields on the merchant web page may be received. The request may include a call to a function in a scripting file provided by the third party, and the provided file may cause one or more inline frames to be rendered in the web browser, each inline frame including a sensitive data form field. Data entered by the user in the sensitive data form fields may be received by a third party payment processor device.
